configuration.changes: Use frozen parent C16 sources and flags in an independent verification workspace; no quantization, parameter interface, dataset, threshold or parent-workspace changes. Limit per-run placement/routing to 4 threads while synthesis remains single-threaded; preserve the serial hardware lock. Exit Vivado after synthesis/report, then reopen the new project in a fresh process for implementation/report; retain the cumulative three-hour tool timeout and one-heavy scheduling. Change only the implementation clock constraint; preserve parent HLS RTL.
configuration.conclusion: Compare measured frame cycles and implementation timing before selecting the final integration candidate. Review unattended section6 decisions with the user tomorrow.

estimates.basis: Frozen C16 HLS resource/cycle measurements. Full-image C validation preserves arithmetic; RTL includes finite-FIFO/AXI behavior. Physical resources and timing remain unknown until routed reports. No board measurement is inferred. Decision basis: Launch only after C19 accepts both complete changed-parameter RTL transactions with exact E017-compatible outputs. C16 has passed the complete 13-image precision and HLS screen. W30 and W32 independently close 4.5 ns on the same part, providing a measured initial physical target for this new FIFO16 plus FRP combination; those prior results do not establish this candidate timing. Use fresh synthesis/report and implementation/report processes, cumulative three-hour timeout, one heavy task, 18 GiB implementation registration and serial_after_oom. Compare matching C19 measured cycles times this independently closed clock against W30 2.472471 ms, and archive all strict setup/hold/route/resource gates; no board result is inferred.
